name: Bossa brush kit
desc: Soft bossa nova kit: surdo-style dotted kick, cross-stick rim playing the two-bar bossa clave, brushed shaker swish and whispering hats; everything lowpassed and low-gain-ratio for the Rio apartment feel.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ [bd ~] bd ~ ~ [bd ~]").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.6).shape(.15).lpf(900), s("[~ sh]*4").gain("[0 .22]*4").lpf(${cut}), s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.3).lpf(${cut}).pan(.58)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.72).shape(.18).lpf(950), s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.42).lpf(${cut}).pan(.58), s("sh*8").gain("[.3 .14 .2 .12]*2").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}).slow(24)).pan(sine.range(.42,.56).slow(16)), s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.2).lpf(${cut}*.9)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] [~ bd]").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.2).lpf(1000), s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ rim").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.46).lpf(${cut}).pan(.58), s("sh*16").gain("[.32 .13 .2 .12]*4").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.1).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)), s("~ hh ~ [hh hh]").gain(.26).lpf(${cut}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd").slow(2).gain(.24).lpf(2200)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
